purpose: Review workspace-scoped charging history alongside departure posture, cost, charging trends, deterministic exceptions, charger insights and a fleet shared-charger queue advisor.
primaryGoal: Find, inspect, compare and export charging sessions while distinguishing live readiness from retained or unverified state and bounded recorded history from complete-range evidence.

dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-enabled query; key ['charging', vehicleId, start, end, limit, offset]; AbortSignal forwarded; FAST stale time and safeArray. One bounded response drives all client filtering, pagination, trends and period statistics. Desktop heading and overview provenance explicitly disclose up to 500 loaded sessions.
dataSources.units: Wh, W, m and source timestamps remain raw API/cache values. Existing view models and CSV convert to kWh, kW and minutes; JSON exports raw rows.
dataSources.backendLimits: Registration confirmed; list handler, server cap, ordering, live enrichment and exact start/end semantics not inspected or exercised.

dataSources.endpoint: GET /api/v1/vehicles/<id>/state (with existing withAsOf query when time-machine mode is active)
dataSources.behavior: Enabled for positive IDs; live query policy and existing STANDARD polling except as-of snapshots. Response includes state, live, observedAt, freshness and verifiedFields. Page consumes state and useDataState but does not check per-field trust.
dataSources.backendLimits: Current-state handler and time_to_full_charge wire units were not traced; do not assume the page's hours-to-minutes conversion proves the wire contract.

dataSources.behavior: Independent vehicle-only source with SLOW stale time and AbortSignal. No workspace range supplied. Existing OptimizerSection explicitly calls its bounds unknown and savings illustrative, not measured.
dataSources.backendLimits: Backend history bounds and tariff/currency contract unverified.

dataSources.behavior: requiresLiveMode=true; shared confirmation toolbar; success/error toasts and broadcast invalidation. Response supports deleted and failed IDs. Page clears selection after any resolved response.
dataSources.eligibility: No page/card/table completed-only selection guard observed. Inspected handler and repository delete by existing ID without an ended_at predicate. This is current source behavior, not authorization to silently change eligibility or proof that deleting an active session is operationally safe.

dataSources.owner: Fleet vehicles hook and existing queue-advice hook
dataSources.behavior: Deliberately fleet-wide business form, independent of selected workspace vehicle/range. User supplies current/target SOC, ready-by time and charger power; default form inputs are not measured live readings. Advice is user-initiated; no request was executed.
dataSources.units: Inspected QueueAdviseRequest still sends charger_kw; response slot exposes kwh_needed and slack_hours. This existing non-SI contract requires coordinated integration review, not a unilateral UI rename.

dataSources.owner: Existing workspace, timezone, formatting and preference infrastructure
dataSources.behavior: Header owns selection; /charging is range-enabled at workspaceScope.ts:29. persistKey charging.list.range, vehicle timezone, URL calendar bounds and exact server instants retained. Display distance conversion occurs at the boundary; no competing local workspace picker.
dataSources.limits: Shared hooks' internal persistence, DST handling and settings endpoints were not independently traced.

components.name: PageLayout / PageHeaderSticky / PullToRefresh
components.contract: Existing category imports; compact header, copy link, saved views, query health and sticky charging-overview target; pull refresh refetches sessions only.

components.name: ChargingEvidenceTable / DataTable / DataTableValueFilter
components.contract: 14 columns including actions; stable tableId charging:evidence; SI filter values, persisted URL grid_values, resize/reorder, external sorting/pagination, cross-page selection merge, preview and typed toolbar controls. Default-hidden peak power, range, rate and score remain available.

components.name: ChargingSessionCard / HistoryListRow
components.contract: Below 1024px: date groups, source location, score, charger badge, energy, duration, optional battery/power/cost/range, selection and quick preview. Compact density hides secondary metrics but detail navigation remains.

components.name: ChargingOverviewStats / ChargingSummaryBrief / OperationalBrief
components.contract: Six distinct aggregates; specialized Delta comparisons, raw canonical metric values, missing-cost reason, prior-period label, bounded-source period provenance, loading/retained state and overview recovery.

components.name: MetricSwitcherChart / ChartContainer
components.contract: Four persisted metric identities; selected-series chart and accessible dataColumns forwarded to canonical ChartContainer. Do not replace with a decorative chart or remove data alternatives.

components.name: ChargingInsights
components.contract: AC/DC panel, battery distribution, measured delivery rate, four charger-spec groups and independent optimizer; battery/spec threshold 5, optimizer threshold 10. Keeps explanatory efficiency and optimizer scope limitations.

components.name: ChargeQueuePlanner
components.contract: Fleet business form using existing Input/Button/Badge; 2-vehicle prerequisite, pending/error/result, ordered slots and feasibility. Do not remove it as a competing workspace selector.

components.name: EntityPreviewDrawer
components.contract: Six fields, active/completed/unknown distinction, full session details and related vehicle/drives/location/alerts/service/signals destinations. Retain original contextual bounds and signal identities.

components.name: FilterBar / ActiveFilterChips / SavedViewMenu / BulkActionsToolbar / ListExportMenu
components.contract: Existing shared owners for URL search/collection/value filters, saved views, selection confirmation and CSV/JSON scopes; preserve stable IDs and shared accessibility behavior.

components.name: QueryError / StaleRefreshWarning / DataStateNotice / EmptyState / Skeleton
components.contract: Historical and live failures independent; retained rows survive refresh failures; named sections, reset/retry and governed onboarding guidance are present.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Mobile composes sort/density/export controls separately from desktop TableControls at 1056. Two render strategies are intentional, but labels, callbacks and scope contracts are repeated.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse the existing typed table-control configuration where compatible; retain mobile controls and desktop grid rather than creating a second table engine.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Insights import rounded durationMinutes(startedAt, endedAt), while list/stats use fractional durationMinutes(session) from chargingAggregation.ts:68. Rate and duration results can differ for sub-minute evidence.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Record and test the specialist semantics before any consolidation; share a computation only after proving parity or explicitly correcting the discrepancy.

responsive.sourceStrategy: Desktop evidence grid at min-width 1024; date-grouped cards and separate controls below it. Overview/trend single-column; insights expand to 6 columns only at 2xl. Queue rows reflow 2 to 4 columns; optimizer habits expand at lg. DataTable has bounded internal height and resizable columns.
responsive.verification: All ten contract viewport widths, container widths, RTL, long labels and 200% text are unverified.

issues.detail: Mobile groups rows by date and re-sorts group keys by sortDesc even when selected sort is energy/cost/duration/power; desktop preserves the global sortedSessions order. The same sort control therefore has different visible ordering across the breakpoint.
issues.fix: Preserve current grouping capability and explicitly reconcile non-date sort presentation; verify identical membership, selection and export scope at 1023/1024px.

issues.detail: The heatmap uses min-w-[600px] within horizontal overflow. This intentionally preserves all 168 cells, but touch navigation and discoverability at 320px are not established.
issues.fix: Exercise internal scrolling and provide an existing accessible data alternative; preserve every weekday/hour value rather than deleting columns for mobile.

accessibility.sourceEvidence: Four explicitly named page sections, labeled preview/selection actions, 44px preview buttons, table caption/row labels, canonical chart dataColumns and shared primitives are present. HistoryListRow puts checkbox and action controls outside its navigation link and reveals actions on focus-within.
accessibility.verification: Browser keyboard/focus, screen-reader output, composed contrast, target spacing, forced colors and reduced motion unverified.

issues.detail: Heatmap role=img has only a generic description; per-cell values exist in native title attributes on non-focusable divs at 103-118. No equivalent value table or keyboard-accessible cell detail is rendered in this component.
issues.fix: Compose the existing chart frame/data-table alternative with weekday/hour/session/cost columns, preserving all cells and mouse/touch evidence; do not add a competing tooltip engine.

issues.detail: Tiny text sits within saturated proportional 16px split segments; small percentages can constrain labels. Actual clipping and composed contrast require measurement, not a token-name pass.
issues.fix: Keep textual AC/DC totals and table; use restrained semantic fills and accessible labels outside narrow geometry when necessary.

states.loading: Overview and session rows have skeletons; trend skeleton and insights loading are present. The secondary OperationalBrief has no loading prop, and fleet queue only reads vehicles.data.
states.empty: Session empty/reset/guidance, missing-vehicle early return, insight thresholds and shared queue prerequisite exist. Some insight shells disappear entirely when no source or usable measurement exists.
states.error: History QueryError, retained warning and independent live partial notice exist. Optimizer only passes data, discarding its error/loading/refresh state. Fleet queue conflates unresolved vehicle source with fewer than two cars.
states.staleOffline: useDataState and separate provenance badges retain history/live data; no runtime offline case was exercised. Source freshness of vehicle fields is not enforced by the operational narrative.

issues.detail: OperationalBrief receives neither loading nor a fatal-history guard. While history is unresolved or failed, currentStats.count defaults to zero, chargingAttention adds 'No charging activity', and narrative reports zero sessions/energy. Session empty state also renders after initial failure despite the error notice above at line 842.
issues.fix: Carry each source's loading/fatal/retained/empty distinction into its own metrics, attention and narrative; only resolved empty history may assert no activity. Keep live metrics independently usable.

issues.detail: Only optimizer.data is retained; ChargingInsights receives no optimizer query state. At ten or more sessions a pending/failed/missing optimizer results in no optimizer shell or recovery.
issues.fix: Pass the existing query/data-state contract to the optimizer section and retain its shell, independent bounds, recommendations and retry; do not let optimizer failure hide session insights.

issues.detail: Vehicle loading/failure is reduced to vehicles ?? [] and shown as 'Add a second vehicle'. A retained vehicle response has no warning. It is not proof of a single-car fleet.
issues.fix: Use the existing source-state notices, skeleton and retry while retaining valid queue form/result; resolve the actual two-vehicle prerequisite only after source success.

issues.detail: AC/DC and delivery-rate panels are conditional on derived data, and battery/spec/optimizer shells disappear at zero sessions. Completed-session wording does not itself filter open rows; thresholds use all returned rows.
issues.fix: Keep specialist panel names and explicit prerequisite/unknown states visible; document actual eligibility and preserve thresholds without silently substituting different session populations.

visualIssues.detail: Four fixed green/cyan/red/purple hex series colors and active-pill accents bypass the current saved chart palette. Cost is red by default regardless of an actual adverse finding.
visualIssues.fix: Use the existing chart-palette/token owner with stable metric identities and subdued default accents; retain user opt-in palette choices and series distinctions.

visualIssues.detail: Recommendations use bg-neon-amber/bg-neon-green plus fixed white surfaces/borders; battery score has fixed saturated colors at 98. Queue slots similarly use bg-white/[0.03] at ChargeQueuePlanner.tsx:145.
visualIssues.fix: Compose existing neutral surfaces and semantic severity tokens; preserve priority text, score, savings and explicit user palette preferences.

visualIssues.detail: TimeStamp and metadata use ad-hoc text-sm/font-semibold/text-2xs instead of role typography. Spec/optimizer headings and AC/DC metadata contain similar custom typography.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse current Caption/Text/PanelTitle roles with semantic as overrides; preserve tabular numbers, hierarchy and settings.

architectureIssues.detail: Bulk delete invalidates ['charging-sessions'], but this page reads ['charging', ...] at line 128. invalidateAndBroadcast only forwards the supplied prefix (queryBroadcast.ts:68-74), so successful deletion does not directly invalidate the mounted list or its derived summaries.
architectureIssues.fix: Extend the existing mutation's invalidation to the actual paginated key family and affected detail/derived sources, retaining query keys, broadcasts and mutation guard; verify successful and partial results.

architectureIssues.detail: Any resolved bulk-delete response clears all selected IDs, ignoring failed[] from the response. The backend computes not_found/conflict per ID; remaining failures can lose their selection context.
architectureIssues.fix: Consume returned outcomes through the existing bulk workflow, retain failed selection and actionable feedback, and clear only confirmed successes; preserve explicit confirmation and live-only guard.

architectureIssues.detail: isChargingNow and departure readiness inspect raw is_charging/battery_level without verifiedFields/freshness/observedAt. A successful stale/durable/as-of response can be labeled 'Charging now' or near-term-ready. Existing useVehicles.ts:1117-1128 already owns field-current checks.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing per-field trust and as-of semantics for current claims; retain historical/retained values with explicit provenance and unknown readiness rather than zero/offline. Do not create a new trust registry.

architectureIssues.detail: Prior-period stats are derived from the same response requested only for the current exact bounds. Under the intended server range filtering, prior data is absent by construction; unavailable labeling is honest but no independent prior source is fetched.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve unavailable comparison wording. If comparisons are restored, request a separately scoped prior source or an existing server aggregate and carry its own trust/completeness; do not fabricate zero deltas.

architectureIssues.detail: One 500-row window backs range summary and trend; overview exposes completeness unknown and desktop heading discloses the bound, but mobile export/list and trend have no equally explicit local loaded-window context.
architectureIssues.fix: Retain bounded behavior and label each affected view/export. Full-range aggregates require verified server support or explicit pagination, not filtering the current page or inventing lifetime coverage.

architectureIssues.detail: computeStartLevelDist maps non-finite start_soc_pct to 0, counting unknown values as observed 0-10% SOC. Missing charger types similarly fall into AC in computeAcDcBreakdown at 173-177.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve all records while distinguishing unknown SOC/charger evidence from measured zero/confirmed AC; review domain calculations explicitly rather than hiding rows or silently changing counts during styling.

architectureIssues.detail: distanceAddedM derives 'Range added' from end_odometer_m - start_odometer_m, an odometer distance change rather than a proven battery range gain. It is consumed by the table, value filters and mobile card.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep raw meter values and existing capability visible; resolve the intended source/label with the domain owner before any calculation change. Do not invent range telemetry.

architectureIssues.detail: Queue request sends charger_kw and displays kwh_needed (types/charging.ts:239-250); these are existing non-SI wire fields, not merely display conversions.
architectureIssues.fix: Track a coordinated backend/type/hook SI cutover dependency. Preserve existing request compatibility until integration changes are owned; no unilateral field rename or legacy adapter in a cosmetic page pass.

architectureIssues.detail: formatHour hardcodes English AM/PM and 12-hour presentation. chargingAggregation.ts:359-405 returns hardcoded English anomaly messages/actions, while optimizer currency displays hardcode dollar signs at OptimizerSection.tsx:44-47,69,168.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse existing timezone/date/locale/currency formatting and canonical translation mechanisms without altering anomaly thresholds, ordering, source currency or user text.

architectureIssues.detail: Several shared implementations are imported through concrete paths in this feature: ActionableEmptyState, DensityToggle, SortControl; card imports Checkbox similarly. Contract requires feature category barrels, unlike shared-internal imports.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing category exports where available; report missing barrel exports to their shared owner instead of editing shared files or creating wrappers.

order: Correct source trust and unresolved-versus-empty claims without losing retained history or independent live data.
Resolve paginated-key invalidation and partial bulk-result reporting; explicitly retain current eligibility until integration policy is verified.
Carry optimizer/fleet source states and preserve every insight shell and threshold.
Restore heatmap value accessibility and responsive parity before visual acceptance.
Adopt restrained existing palette/typography/surface owners without changing wire units, exports or persistence.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Charging mutation cache invalidation
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing useBulkDeleteCharging: retain requiresLiveMode, existing mutation/result contract and cross-tab broadcast; invalidate the existing ['charging', ...] family as well as charging-sessions and affected detail caches on successful/partial deletion.
usedBy: other existing charging hook consumers (not inventoried in this scope)

requiredSharedChanges.name: Queue-advice SI contract integration
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing QueueAdviseRequest/QueueSlot expose charger_kw/kwh_needed/slack_hours. A coordinated integration must define canonical power/energy/duration fields and display-boundary conversions, retaining defaults, feasibility, ready-by and result explanation.
dependsOn: POST /api/v1/charge-planner/queue backend contract; handler implementation uninspected

competingImplementations.detail: Two current duration helpers differ in signature and rounding; this is a concrete dependency mismatch, not evidence to delete specialist behavior.
competingImplementations.fix: Keep both until precision/equivalence is tested; use the existing calculation owner when adopting a proven common contract.

competingImplementations.detail: No competing local workspace vehicle/date picker observed. Fleet queue inputs are independent planning business fields and intentionally include multiple cars.
competingImplementations.fix: Retain header ownership and the fleet business form; do not remove queue capability under a workspace-selector cleanup.

competingImplementations.detail: The glow prop name is not proof of glowing shadows: inspected GlassPanel.tsx:31-35 maps it to hover border tint and shared neutral elevation.
competingImplementations.fix: Reuse the existing surface owner; subdue only source-confirmed color noise, not a speculative legacy glass/glow implementation.

preservation.sourceHashScope: Exact root page file bytes, not a dependency graph or normalized source hash.

Operational charging posture; six metrics, attention, narrative and provenance
Charging insights: AC/DC, battery start distribution, delivery rate, charger specifications, optimizer
Optimizer subsections: conditional savings banner, habits, battery-friendly score, cost analysis, heatmap, recommendations
Session preview drawer with related context

actions: Header copy link and saved-view apply; pull-to-refresh and source retry.
Search free text plus charger/cost/kwh/power/dur/in/at/free tokens; deferred-search pending indicator.
URL collections all/home/supercharger/dc/free/anomalies/notable/tagged; tagged currently returns [] and is not an implemented tagging capability.
Per-column available-value filters, chips, invalid-filter clearing and reset; mobile clear with desktop-edit explanation.
Sort date/energy/cost/duration/power ascending/descending; compact/comfortable density; page and size changes.
Grid reorder/resize/default-hidden columns; multi-page bulk selection, clear, confirmation and live-only deletion.
CSV and JSON exports of all filtered/sorted loaded rows or selected rows; 'visible' is not merely current paginated rows.
Anomaly collection shortcut; overview comparisons and four trend metrics plus canonical chart data alternative.
Fleet queue form, Plan queue action, pending/error/result and feasibility.
Session preview/open details; related vehicle, drives, optional location, inbox, maintenance and signals.
dataBehavior: Preserve raw SI session payloads/cache, original JSON export fields, exact server range instants and vehicle timezone. Do not guess legacy live ETA units.
Current CSV explicitly exports kwh/duration_min/avg_kw/peak_kw derived display values; preserve format compatibility until a separately owned SI/export contract change, not a cosmetic rename.
Overview/trend use date-filtered loaded rows independently of search/collections/value filters; insights use loaded sessions; optimizer has independent unknown bounds; queue is fleet-wide.
Range changes reset page. Search/value filters also reset page. Keep q/coll/trend/sort/sort_desc/density/page/size/grid_values and charging.list.range identities.
Selection is pruned to filtered membership, not just current page; table changes merge selections across pages.
Only cost_decimal === 0 qualifies as free; missing cost is not free. Rate calculations exclude unusable durations where currently specified.
Open/malformed session duration shows unknown placeholder, not a measured zero-length session; no silent switch to completed-only counts, exports or selection.

Active-session eligibility currently has no client or inspected repository ended_at restriction. Retain current behavior for presentation work and surface any required domain-policy correction as a separate integration dependency.
Keep separate fatal/refresh errors and retained data, optimizer illustrative-savings caveats, efficiency-not-measured explanation and reliability-not-SLA wording.
Keep stable table IDs charging:evidence and charging:ac-dc-stats; charging-overview sticky target, search historyScope charging and saved-view route /charging.
Keep all preview destinations and signals ACChargingPower/DCChargingPower/BatteryLevel; drawer scope changes and stale preview behavior require acceptance rather than invented reset semantics.
preservation.lineCountPolicy: Any future decomposition must count root plus extracted feature components against this baseline; this audit changes no source and is not a modernization parity certificate.
